typography_notes: sans-serif throughout; title is bold red and underlined; node labels use colored sans-serif matching node fill; equations mix black, red, blue, and green colored terms; subscripts are smaller and lowered
animation_state: static slide, all elements fully visible, no mid-build indication
recreation_brief: 1. Create white-background slide. 2. Add text box top-left with 'At Hidden Layer' in bold red sans-serif, underlined. 3. Add yellow oval top-right with black text '21'. 4. Draw large rectangle with red border (no fill) spanning middle-upper area. 5. Inside it, draw three blue circles vertically on left, each labeled O_i in blue. 6. Draw one red circle with light green fill in center, labeled δ_j in red. 7. Draw three orange circles vertically on right, each labeled δ_k in orange. 8. Add arrows from each left circle to center labeled w_ji; add arrows from center to each right circle labeled w_kj. 9. Add upward arrow below center node labeled j. 10. Inside large rectangle, add light green box with equation: Δ_ji (black) = η (red) O_i (blue) O_j(1-O_j) (green) [Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)] (red). 11. Add separate white rectangle with red border at bottom containing: Δ_ji (black) = η (red) O_i (blue) δ_j (red); below it 'Where:' then δ_j (red) = O_j(1-O_j) (green) [Σ_k (δ_k w_kj)] (red).
